topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and the Microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic establishes the lecture by setting out its context, key themes, and learning objectives.

topics.label: Genetic Clonal Evolution and Epigenetic Alterations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications drive clonal selection and malignant transformation.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the hierarchical organization of tissues and provide experimental evidence for cancer stem cells driving tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Drivers of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how chronic inflammation, environmental promoters, and supportive stroma are necessary to enable and sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Tumor Heterogeneity and Microenvironments
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial technologies used to analyze tumor cell states and interactions in tissue.

topics.label: Synthesis of the Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the lecture's core themes into a unified evolutionary framework involving mutations, cellular context, and environmental factors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic concludes the session and previews the subject of the next lecture.
